subject: A {bedrooms}-bedroom home in {city} for the {surname} family
body:
Hi {givenName},

This is the Habitat OC team checking in on the {surname} family plan. We're building a {bedrooms}-bedroom home in {city} that should be finished in {completion}, and your plan puts you on track for {readyDate}.
